authority.rule: The companion may inspect and prepare exact mutation proposals. It must not execute mutations or treat chat approval, ConfigHub revision approval, or a local confirmation flag as execution authorization.

cub_client.provenance_caveat: cub version and Go build metadata bind the advertised v0.2.11 commit and this exact binary hash, but go version -m reports vcs.modified=true, the module version is (devel), signing is ad hoc, and no Homebrew receipt or official release-asset checksum was found. Treat source semantics as reviewed for this hash, not the binary as an authenticated official release asset.

unselected_profiles.reason: The v0.2.10 client / v0.2.11 server tuple is not the installed authoritative profile and must not be selected by this companion.

current_delivery_contract.effective_release_set: Units in the selected Space whose Unit.TargetID equals Space.ReleaseTargetID
current_delivery_contract.release_revision_tagged: At execution, each effective Unit resolves to the highest Revision currently carrying TagID; tag membership is mutable and is not an immutable RevisionID/DataHash pin.
current_delivery_contract.untagged_publish_side_effect: When --revision is omitted, publication also creates release-<ReleaseNum> and adds that TagID to every bundled Revision.
current_delivery_contract.scope_rule: No Unit, Filter, ChangeSet, cross-Space selector, expected TargetID, expected TagID-to-RevisionID/DataHash mapping, or expected ordered manifest is accepted by release publish. Any narrower intent must be re-presented as whole-Space scope, but review still cannot atomically bind provider execution.

helm_contract.unit_granularity: one Unit per chart template file; CRD files are separate file-derived Units
helm_contract.values_compatibility_shape: independent <component>-<environment>-helm/base plus environment Variant using --space-pattern template:{{.Labels.Component}} per materially different values set

known_semantic_gaps.client_help_claim: A Unit with no matching tagged Revision falls back to its head Revision.
known_semantic_gaps.reviewed_source_observation: The exact installed server commit returns an error when an effective Unit has no Revision carrying the requested Tag, despite its nearby comment and client help describing head fallback.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: For --revision release proposals, require every effective Unit to have the exact tag and bind the resulting RevisionID/DataHash set. Otherwise return BLOCK.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: No trusted external verifier is integrated to authenticate approval of an exact mutation proposal.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Keep all create, update, approve, promote, publish, withdraw, install, and delete operations proposal-only.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Claude PreToolUse exposes raw shell text, not final argv. The retired regex/prefix autoallow admitted credentials, secrets, file/plugin/refresh side effects and shell expansion while falsely denying legitimate quoted predicates.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Grant no Bash autoallow. Preserve skill-specific read UX through host ASK until a typed wrapper receives skill/capability identity and structured final argv or typed fields, rejects unknown values, and produces a receipt.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Server v0.2.11 rejects every nonempty approval selector except HeadRevisionNum. Omitted/HeadRevisionNum approves the head inside the execution transaction with no expected HeadRevisionNum, RevisionID, or DataHash precondition.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Describe native approval as head-at-execution only. Mark non-head selectors VERSIONED_LEGACY/BLOCK and exact reviewed-artifact approval APPROVAL_HEAD_RACE_BLOCK until a server/API precondition exists.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Server v0.2.11 unit_update.go createUpdateFunction can transactionally compare caller-supplied HeadRevisionNum plus DataHash/ContentHash with the current Unit inside RunInTx. Raw patch bodies can carry those fields. However, the protected companion has no digest-pinned catalog operation that binds the reviewed per-Unit values into final requests and receipts, and stock restore/function/variant-promotion convenience paths do not prove that the approved set was the set checked and mutated.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Do not claim the provider lacks a Unit CAS primitive. Return APPROVED_STATE_CAS_NOT_INTEGRATED for authoritative restore, update, patch, function/run, and promotion execution until a protected typed action binds every UnitID, expected HeadRevisionNum, DataHash/ContentHash, requested effect, and resulting RevisionID in one reviewed artifact and receipt.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Release publish re-resolves Space.ReleaseTargetID, membership, revisions, TagID-to-RevisionID/DataHash mapping, and gates during execution but accepts no expected target, expected tag mapping, ordered Unit/revision manifest, or proposal digest. A Tag is mutable and the server chooses the highest Revision currently carrying it. Untagged publication also creates release-<ReleaseNum> and tags every bundled Revision.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Treat ReleaseProposal as advisory and return RELEASE_EXECUTION_CAS_BLOCK even if an external broker later approves it. Bind the expected tag mapping and untagged auto-tag side effect in the approval subject, and require provider-atomic expected-target/tag-mapping/manifest preconditions before authoritative execution.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Release.UnitCount and the current EffectiveReleaseSet do not identify historical membership. Revision.Releases can reconstruct members only while all linked Revisions survive. Release deletion removes the row, bundle, and server-held manifest/digests even if stale Revision links survive; Revision deletion can erase membership reconstruction.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Persist a governed UnitID/RevisionID/RevisionNum/DataHash publication receipt, cross-check Revision.Releases, and block on same-count swaps, deleted members, or missing receipts.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: The public Release resource exposes no TargetID or stored Manifest. Server v0.2.11 writes com.confighub.target.id into the OCI manifest committed by ManifestDigest, but cub release get/list cannot return that annotation. Current Space.ReleaseTargetID is not historical evidence.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Require a trusted publication receipt containing the digest-matching OCI manifest and target annotation, or an equivalent reviewed digest-addressed registry proof. Otherwise return HISTORICAL_RELEASE_TARGET_UNPROVEN.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Server v0.2.11 withdrawal checks DestroyGates on current target membership rather than necessarily the withdrawn Release's original members.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Compare receipt/Revision.Releases original membership with the current server gate set and return WITHDRAWAL_MEMBERSHIP_DRIFT_BLOCK on any retargeting or proof gap.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Server v0.2.11 Release Delete hard-deletes the row/bundle without calling Withdraw or checkDestroyGates, including when the Release is still Published.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Require a verified Published=false withdrawal receipt plus retained target/member/digest evidence before deletion. Return RELEASE_DELETE_STILL_PUBLISHED_BLOCK for a published Release and never claim DestroyGates are provider-enforced on delete.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: The former cub v0.2.10 / server v0.2.11 tuple is not the installed authoritative profile.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Keep that tuple unselected and blocked; validate the exact v0.2.11/v0.2.11 versions, commits, and client binary hash instead.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: cub worker logs selects ~/.confighub/worker/log/<slug>.log without SpaceID/WorkerID binding. --tail still scans the complete file, and the command has no input/output byte cap or credential redaction. Worker and Kubernetes log text is untrusted and may contain secrets.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Remove log commands from the read evidence subset and return WORKER_LOG_EVIDENCE_BLOCK until a protected wrapper binds identity, seeks a bounded byte window, caps input/output, redacts credentials, disables follow, and receipts truncation.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Raw Helm/Kustomize rendering can fetch remote or mutable inputs, traverse symlinks, load plugins/generators, execute chart/overlay extensions, and produce unbounded output. A version string is not an immutable chart digest, and current raw commands do not enforce source closure, network-off execution, or byte/resource ceilings.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Preflight only canonical local source metadata. Return RENDER_SOURCE_POLICY_BLOCK on any remote/plugin/exec/unpinned/unbounded input and until a digest-pinned, network-off, source-closed, byte/resource-capped wrapper emits a trusted render receipt.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Static checks do not prove a controller consumed a particular OCI manifest digest or that runtime resources converged.
known_semantic_gaps.policy: Require read-only controller and runtime receipts or name the proof gap.

claim_boundary: Passing tools/validate-current-surface proves static inventory and negative-boundary consistency for this exact profile. It does not make the plugin activation-ready, mutation-ready, provider-CAS-safe, behaviorally no-loss, or live-delivery-proven.
